# Dhruv Salian

Software Engineering major • Data Science minor • International student
I’m a full-stack software engineer focused on developer tooling, platform engineering, release automation, and scalable web applications. This year, I’ve been building systems that remove the guesswork from complex multi-service deployments modeling service dependencies as directed graphs, generating topologically sorted release plans, and creating structured runbooks that help engineering teams ship with more confidence, consistency, and failure awareness. I also enjoy building product-facing software that is fast, intuitive, and reliable. I’ve developed scalable REST APIs and dynamic React/Node.js experiences that improved page load times by 30%, because performance, usability, and clean architecture all shape the user experience.



My stack includes React, Next.js, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, REST APIs, and modern web technologies. I’m especially drawn to work where strong engineering improves how people build, ship, and use software. I care deeply about thoughtful design, developer experience, system reliability, and building products that don’t just work, they make life easier. I’m currently completing my B.S. in Computer Science at Cal State Monterey Bay, with a minor in Data Science, and I’m seeking opportunities in full-stack engineering, platform engineering, developer infrastructure, and developer-facing products. I’m excited to build tools and systems that make software teams faster, safer, and more effective.

Welcome to my portfolio.
